profile.headline: Software Engineer | Backend & Cloud Infrastructure, Frontend | Java, Python, Kubernetes, Terraform, Apache Spark, Javascript, React | Scalable Systems & Cost Optimization
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience in backend development, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), I design and optimize high-performance APIs, scalable microservices, and data pipelines that improve cloud efficiency for enterprise customers.

Key Achievements:
- Reduced API latency by 99% by optimizing Java-based RESTful APIs.
- Engineered & deployed a Spark-based cost analysis system, helping OCI customers reduce cloud spending by 70%.
- Transitioned a full service from JSON to Parquet, improving data pipeline efficiency by 4x.
- Built real-time monitoring solutions using Kubernetes & Terraform, reducing operational overhead by 50%.

I am passionate about building scalable, high-performance systems, optimizing cloud infrastructure, and solving complex engineering challenges. Open to opportunities in backend engineering, cloud computing, and distributed systems. Let’s connect!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained scalable microservices for the Mass Customization Platform, enabling seamless onboarding and management of manufacturers.
- Optimized backend processes with Node.js and PostgreSQL, improving search filtering response times by 15% and reducing order processing times by 10%.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to define system requirements, enhance platform scalability, and deliver high-performance web applications.
- Contributed to architecture design, backlog prioritization, and QA processes, ensuring timely feature delivery and maintainable codebases.

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped build a church in Port Au Prince, Haiti and took care of orphans at various orphanages around Haiti.

projects.title: Detecting State of Mind through Tracked Movement Data
projects.description: Collected data using Unity 3D and C# and will use this and previous data to develop machine learning algorithms in R that will predict emotional states and traits during interactions in a virtual environment.

projects.title: EMOTUS Mobile Application
projects.description: A hackathon winning android application created during Boston College’s hackathon motivated by the idea of autistic children. Wanted to help autistic children learn emotions by creating a game that helped them identify emotions better.  Caught the interest of Boston University researchers interested in autism.
